title: Smart Data Models - HSDS - Program
description: The details of collections of related services. (Human Services Data Specification 3.3.1, object 'program': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json. Field names are kept verbatim (snake_case) except 'id' -> 'hsdsId'.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity (NGSI-LD): urn:ngsi-ld:Program:<HSDS id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Program'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hsdsId.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/id'. The identifier for the program. Each program must have a unique identifier. HSDS field 'id', renamed because 'id' is reserved in NGSI-LD.

organization_id.description: Relationship. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/organization_id'. The identifier for the organization which the program belongs to. Each program must belong to a single organization, and the identifier for that organization should be given here. In HSDS this is an HSDS identifier (uuid); here it holds the URN of the Organization entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Organization:<HSDS id>).

name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/name'. The name of the program.

alternate_name.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/alternate_name'. The (optional) alternative name for the program.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/description'. A free text description of the program

attributes.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/attributes'. A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided.

metadata.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/program.json#/properties/metadata'. A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

attribute.title: attribute
attribute.description: A link between a service and one or more classifications that describe the nature of the service provided. (HSDS object 'attribute': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/attribute.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier of the attribute entry. Each attribute entry should have a unique identifier.

link_id.title: Link Identifier
link_id.description: The identifier of the entity to which this taxonomy term applies.

taxonomy_term_id.title: Taxonomy Term Identifier
taxonomy_term_id.description: The identifier of this taxonomy term from the taxonomy table.

link_type.title: Link Type
link_type.description: A code taken from an enumerated open codelist to indicate what the taxonomy term describes, e.g. the service eligibility or intended audience.

link_entity.title: Link Entity
link_entity.description: The table of the Link Identifier.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value (if any) of an attribute.

taxonomy_term.title: Taxonomy Term
taxonomy_term.description: Each service can be categorized according to one or more taxonomy terms. The taxonomy_term object contains a list of taxonomy terms, their names, and, for hierarchical taxonomies, their structure.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

label.title: Label
label.description: A free text label of the attribute.

metadata.title: metadata
metadata.description: A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information. (HSDS object 'metadata': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/metadata.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for this metadata. Each entry must have a unique identifier.

resource_id.title: Resource Identifier
resource_id.description: The identifier of the resource (service, program, location, address, or contact) that this metadata describes.

resource_type.title: Resource Type
resource_type.description: The type of entity being referenced.

last_action_date.title: Last Action Date
last_action_date.description: The date when data was changed. (HSDS tabular type: date.)

last_action_type.title: Last Action Type
last_action_type.description: The kind of change made to the data.

field_name.title: Field Name
field_name.description: The name of field that has been modified.

previous_value.title: Previous Value
previous_value.description: The previous value of the field that has been modified.

replacement_value.title: Replacement Value
replacement_value.description: The new value of the field that has been modified.

updated_by.title: Updated By
updated_by.description: The name of the person who modified the field.

taxonomy.title: taxonomy
taxonomy.description: The taxonomies from which taxonomy terms are taken. (HSDS object 'taxonomy': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/taxonomy.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier of the taxonomy. Each entry must have a unique identifier

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the taxonomy from which terms are sourced.

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description of the taxonomy.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.

taxonomy_term.title: taxonomy_term
taxonomy_term.description: Each service can be categorized according to one or more taxonomy terms. The taxonomy_term object contains a list of taxonomy terms, their names, and, for hierarchical taxonomies, their structure. (HSDS object 'taxonomy_term': https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openreferral/specification/v3.3.1/schema/taxonomy_term.json)

id.title: Identifier
id.description: The identifier for this taxonomy term. Each taxonomy term must have a unique identifier, within the scope of the dataset.

code.title: Code
code.description: The term identfier as used in the taxonomy. This and the taxonomy_id combined define the term.

description.title: Description
description.description: A free text description of the term.

parent_id.title: Parent Identifier
parent_id.description: If this is a child term in a hierarchical taxonomy, give the identifier of the parent category. For top-level categories, this is not required.

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: If this is an established taxonomy, a free text description of which taxonomy is in use. If possible, provide a URI.

taxonomy_detail.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy_detail.description: Taxonomies from which taxonomy terms are taken

language.title: Language
language.description: An ISO 639-1, ISO 639-2, or ISO 639-3 [language code](http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php) to represent the language of the term. The three-letter codes from ISO 639-2 and ISO 639-3 provide greater accuracy when describing variants of languages, which may be relevant to particular communities.

taxonomy_id.title: Taxonomy Identifier
taxonomy_id.description: The identifier of the taxonomy containing the term.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: A record of the changes that have been made to the data in order to maintain provenance information.
